fields.description: The workbook that owns this query, when one does. Ad-hoc queries the agent writes have no workbook and must keep working without one, so this is deliberately not `reqd`.
fields.label: Workbook

fields.description: Flat grouping label within the workbook's Queries section, not a Link: a query may sit at the root.
fields.label: Folder

fields.description: The pipeline, as a JSON list. Validated against the closed operation grammar on save, so a malformed query cannot be stored.
fields.label: Operations

fields.description: Digest of the compiled SQL and the backend it ran against. Permissions compile into that SQL, so two viewers with different access cannot share an entry.
fields.label: Cache Key

fields.description: Whose permissions produced the cache key above. Two viewers with different access run different SQL, so this field names the run, not the query.
fields.label: Last Executed By

fields.description: Names of the other queries this pipeline reads from, flattened transitively on save. Lets the workbook answer "what breaks if I delete this" without walking every pipeline in Python.
fields.label: Linked Queries

fields.description: The answer this query was saved from, if it came from Ask. The run carries the question, the source (verified or generated), the tier and the model, so a stored artifact can still say what produced it. Frappe refuses to delete a run an artifact cites.
fields.label: Saved From Answer
